Class PirateCrew

java.lang.Object
PirateCrew
public final class PirateCrew extends Object
PirateCrew Purpose: Manages a pirate crew and its members.

  • Constructor Details

    • PirateCrew

      public PirateCrew(String crewName, String shipName, Pirate captain)
      CONSTRUCTOR Purpose: Creates a new crew with a generated ID and enrols its captain.
      Parameters:
      crewName - falls back to "Unnamed Crew" if null/blank
      shipName - falls back to "Unnamed Ship" if null/blank
      captain - the founding captain
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if captain is null or already sails with another crew

    • PirateCrew

      public PirateCrew(int id, String crewName, String shipName)
      LOAD CONSTRUCTOR Purpose: Rebuilds an empty crew from persisted data with its original ID preserved. The captain and members are re-attached by the loader afterwards.
      Parameters:
      id - the stored crew ID

    • goodbyeMember

      public boolean goodbyeMember(Pirate pirate)
      Purpose: Removes a pirate from the crew and clears their crew reference. Vacates the captain's seat if the departing pirate held it.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if removed, false otherwise

    • getTotalBounty

      public long getTotalBounty()
      Purpose: Sums the bounties of members whose status is FREE. Captured and dead members contribute nothing, which is how bounty deduction after a capture is handled implicitly.
      Returns:
      the crew's combined active bounty in Berries
